description: How the user buys or starts any Agency Growth plan. Payment always happens in the user's own browser, so this returns the one link they open, what they do there, what happens after, and a message you can pass to them as is. Call list_plans first if the user has not picked a plan. Never enter card details for the user.

plan.description: ai_audit = free audit, diy_plan = DIY implementation plan, starter/team/growth = monthly agent plans, done_for_you = a build quoted from the audit, white_label = agents under an agency's own brand.
